name: Heirs And Graces
source:
Marcel knows two things about his biological father: One, Lord Sandor abandoned him and his mother leaving them to live a of poverty. Two, he shouldn't want anything to do with the man.

Despite this knowledge, Marcel applies for a job as Lord Sandor's servant in order to satisfy his curiosity about the father he never knew. The idea is to get a glimpse and go, but things become more complicated than Marcel initially planned when Lord Sandor recognizes him and makes an offer.

If Marcel can prove that he is worthy, Lord Sandor will name Marcel his heir. It all sounds a little to good to be true, but Marcel is willing to give it a chance - for now.

Play as Marcel and determine whether or not he has the skills to become Lord Sandor's heir and whether or not he forms a romantic attachment to one of four potential love interests: an ex-gladiator turned gardener, a perfectionist butler, the local doctor, or a mischievous elven Lord.

[From [url=http://winterwolves.com/heirsandgraces.htm]Winter Wolves[/url]]
translation:
马塞尔知道关于自己生父的两件事：其一，桑多尔勋爵抛弃了他和母亲，让他们过着贫困的生活；其二，他不该再和那个男人有任何瓜葛。

尽管知道这些，马塞尔还是申请成为桑多尔勋爵的仆人，只为满足自己对陌生生父的好奇。他本打算远远看上一眼就离开，可桑多尔勋爵认出了他，还提出了一项邀约，事情于是变得比马塞尔原先设想的复杂得多。

只要马塞尔能证明自己的价值，桑多尔勋爵就会指定他为继承人。这听起来未免好得有些不真实，但马塞尔愿意暂且试一试。

扮演马塞尔，决定他是否具备成为桑多尔勋爵继承人的能力，并判断他会不会与四位潜在恋爱对象之一发展感情：由前角斗士转职的园丁、追求完美的管家、当地医生，或一位淘气的精灵领主。

[来自[url=http://winterwolves.com/heirsandgraces.htm]Winter Wolves[/url]]
